The ZULF Ritual

Six minutes. Alternate days. A discipline that rewards patience.

I

Warm the Oil

Warm 6 to 8 drops between your palms for twenty seconds until the oil reaches body temperature.

II

Apply to Scalp & Roots

Part your hair and apply directly to the scalp and roots. Lengths may receive what remains on the palms.

III

Massage Gently

Using only your fingertips, massage gently in slow circles for three to five minutes.

IV

Leave to Absorb

Leave the elixir on for a minimum of one hour. For deeper nourishment, leave it overnight.

V

Cleanse

Cleanse with a mild, sulphate-free shampoo. Use on alternate days for best results.

“Consistency is the ritual.”
